---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region_lower = str_to_lower(region))

attacks_by_country <- attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Country_lower)) |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world |>
  left_join(attacks_by_country, by = c("region_lower" = "Country_lower")) |>
  ggplot(aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    trans = "sqrt",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Shark Attacks by Country", fill = "Attacks") +
  theme_void()
```
